workflow: A user enables optional compiler instrumentation during build configuration without installing its required runtime support.
Configuration probes compile and run small test programs with the instrumentation enabled.
The probes fail because the instrumentation runtime is unavailable, but the failure is interpreted as missing ordinary system functionality.
Configuration aborts with a misleading capability or dependency error instead of identifying the missing instrumentation support.
summary: Missing instrumentation runtime misreported as unrelated configuration failure
decision_reason: The failure workflow materially matches the existing cluster: enabling instrumentation causes configuration probes to fail, and the probe failure is misinterpreted as an unrelated capability problem.
